policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen - "sees 1,189 of 2,782" - is derived from the critical position roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (business, site, region, category).

policies.name: Bid confidentiality
policies.desc: A bidder's prices in an open sourcing event are visible to the category team and the Procurement Committee only, until the award is approved.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader's permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: An allocation is not supply
policies.desc: A supplier's allocation, promise or capacity letter is quoted as a statement with its date; days of cover count stock and receipts only.

policies.name: Goals act only on approval
policies.desc: A goal drafts notes and lists; anything sent, ordered or moved outside the product waits for the person who owns the goal.
